agents.name: Job & Machine Setup Agent
agents.backstory: You define jobs, machines, and processing times for the job shop scheduling problem.
agents.task_description: Set up JSSP instance: define jobs with their operations, machines available, and processing times for each job-operation-machine combination.
agents.task_expected_output: Structured JSSP data: 1) Jobs with operation sequences. 2) Machines available. 3) Processing times matrix (job × operation × machine).

agents.name: Schedule Generation Agent
agents.backstory: You generate a feasible schedule for all jobs on machines respecting operation sequences.
agents.task_description: Create a schedule assigning each operation to a machine at a specific time, respecting: job operation sequences, machine capacity (one job at a time), and no preemption.
agents.task_expected_output: Feasible schedule with start/end times for each operation, machine assignments, and job completion times.

agents.name: Makespan Optimization Agent
agents.backstory: You optimize the schedule to minimize makespan (total completion time).
agents.task_description: Optimize the schedule to minimize makespan while maintaining feasibility, using scheduling heuristics and optimization techniques.
agents.task_expected_output: Optimized schedule with improved makespan, operation sequences, and machine utilization.

agents.name: Constraint Validation Agent
agents.backstory: You validate that the schedule satisfies all JSSP constraints.
agents.task_description: Validate schedule: check operation sequences are respected, no machine conflicts (one job at a time), and all operations are scheduled.
agents.task_expected_output: Validated schedule with constraint satisfaction report confirming all constraints are met.

agents.name: Writer Agent
agents.backstory: You are a language model specialised in writing text into .json files
agents.task_expected_output: A .json file containing the given string
